(() => { const base = '{{baseUrl}}'; const pick = (img) => { if (!img) return ''; const attrs = ['data-original','data-src','data-lazy-src','data-loadsrc','realsrc','src']; for (let i = 0; i < attrs.length; i++) { const v = img.getAttribute(attrs[i]) || ''; if (v && !/^data:/i.test(v)) { try { return new URL(v, base).href; } catch (e) { return v; } } } return ''; }; const clean = (v) => String(v || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const title = clean(document.querySelector('.show_cos .title h1')?.textContent || document.querySelector('h1')?.textContent || document.title).replace(/\s*-\s*Cosplay联盟.*$/,''); const cover = pick(document.querySelector('.show_cos .con img')); const desc = clean(document.querySelector('meta[name="description"]')?.getAttribute('content') || document.querySelector('.show_cos .con p')?.textContent || ''); const tags = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.show_cos .footer .tag a, .show_cos .title li')).map((el) => clean(el.textContent)).filter(Boolean); const author = clean(document.querySelector('.show_cos .title li')?.textContent || '').replace(/^.*[：:]/, ''); return JSON.stringify({ title, cover, author, status: 'completed', description: desc, genre: tags.join(', ') }); })();

(() => { const base = '{{baseUrl}}'; const pages = []; const seen = []; const abs = (v) => { try { return new URL(v, location.href || base).href; } catch (e) { return v || ''; } }; const attr = (el) => { if (!el) return ''; const attrs = ['data-original','data-src','data-lazy-src','data-loadsrc','realsrc','src','href']; for (let i = 0; i < attrs.length; i++) { const v = el.getAttribute(attrs[i]) || ''; if (v && !/^data:/i.test(v)) return v; } const style = el.getAttribute('style') || ''; const m = style.match(/url\(['"]?([^'")]+)['"]?\)/i); return m ? m[1] : ''; }; const push = (v) => { if (!v || /^data:/i.test(v)) return; const url = abs(v); if (!/\.(webp|jpg|jpeg|png|gif)(\?|#|$)/i.test(url)) return; if (seen.indexOf(url) >= 0) return; seen.push(url); pages.push({ index: pages.length, url, imageUrl: url }); }; document.querySelectorAll('.show_cos .con img').forEach((img) => push(attr(img))); return JSON.stringify(pages); })();
